description.value: Planet Ice Delta is a large four-rink ice sports facility located near the south end of the Alex Fraser Bridge in Delta. It is home to the Delta Hockey Academy (in partnership with North Delta Secondary School) and hosts numerous adult and youth hockey leagues as well as premier tournaments year-round. The complex includes a pro shop, skate sharpening, a health and performance clinic, and food and beverage options — making it a substantial stop for cyclists exploring the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM front-page URL (index.cfm) returned a 404, but the /delta/ subpage loaded successfully and confirms the facility name, address (10388 Nordel Ct), and phone (604) 930-8727. The website describes a large four-rink ice sports complex with food and beverage venues (Blueline Concessions and Boomers Bar & Grill) explicitly named; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities was found in the available content.
